title: Fact
description: A single Numbers API fact returned in JSON form.

text.example: 42 is the result given by Google and Bing for the query "the answer to life the universe and everything".

number.description: Floating-point number the fact pertains to. For date facts, this is the 1-indexed day of a leap year (e.g. 61 is March 1).

found.description: Whether a real fact was found for the requested number.

date.description: Day of year associated with year facts, as a string (e.g. `June 6`).

year.description: Year associated with date facts, as a string (e.g. `1969`).
